why: The construction-time paint survives and every control still opens showing the stored value, so Settings looks right until the player touches it -- and then the control they just pressed never redraws, because this subscription is the only thing that answers the store. Issue #364's fifth criterion is specifically about the change landing WITH THE PANE OPEN, which is this line and not the call above it, and issue #289's motion toggle is the control where the consequence is visible rather than merely stale: the resolved policy stops reaching `hud.setReducedMotion`, so the transitions the player is trying to change carry on until a reload. The subscribed function became `applyPageSettings` in issue #485, which drives the display and the audio engine from this ONE registration; killing the subscription therefore strands both halves, and the audio cases fail beside the display ones.
